  "normalized_proposals": [
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "5969ee972a59040c9d3d43c586229d6545610f5ab01dff59d03054f15555af28",
      "notes": "User-authorized removal of unadopted mechanism expansions / concise wording.",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/psionic/solipsism.lua",
      "source": "You believe that your mind is the center of everything.  Permanently increases the amount of psi you gain per level by 5 and reduces your life rating (affects life at level up) by 50%% (one time only adjustment).\n\t\tYou also have learned to overcome damage with your mind alone, and convert %d%% of all damage you receive into Psi damage and %d%% of your healing and life regen now recovers Psi instead of life.\n\t\tConverted Psi damage you take will be further reduced by %0.1f%% (%0.1f%% from character level with the remainder further reduced by %0.1f%% from talent level).\n\t\tThe first talent point invested will also increase the amount of Psi you gain from Willpower by 0.5, but reduce the amount of life you gain from Constitution by 0.25.\n\t\tThe first talent point also increases your solipsism threshold by 20%% (currently %d%%), reducing your global speed by 1%% for each percentage your current Psi falls below this threshold.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你相信你的心灵是世间万物的中心。\n\t\t每级永久性增加你 5 点灵能值，并减少你 50%% 的生命成长（影响升级时的生命增益，但只在学习此技能时永久影响一次）。\n\t\t同时你学会用心灵来承受伤害，转化 %d%% 生命削减为灵能值削减，并且 %d%% 的治疗值和回复值会转化为灵能值的增长。\n\t\t转化成的灵能值削减将进一步被减少 %0.1f%% （%0.1f%% 来自于人物等级，剩余部分再受技能等级提供的 %0.1f%% 减免。）\n\t\t首次投入技能点时，每点意志提供的灵能值增加 0.5，每点体质提供的生命值减少 0.25。\n\t\t学习此技能时，你的唯我临界点会增加 20 %%（当前 %d%%）， 你的灵能值每低于这个临界点 1 %%，你的全局速度减少 1 %%。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "0e75811c0ed2c95c53bc9539c98f61987282bf5fc258038685a60d754d8df6d7",
      "notes": "User-authorized removal of unadopted mechanism expansions / concise wording.",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/psionic/solipsism.lua",
      "source": "You now substitute %d%% of your Mental Save for %d%% of your Physical and Spell Saves throws (so at 100%%, you would effectively use mental save for all saving throw rolls).\n\t\tThe first talent point invested will also increase the amount of Psi you gain from Willpower by 0.5, but reduce the amount of life you gain from Constitution by 0.25.\n\t\tLearning this talent also increases your solipsism threshold by 10%% (currently %d%%).",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你现在使用 %d%% 精神豁免值来替代 %d%% 物理和法术豁免（即 100 %%时精神豁免完全替代所有豁免）。\n\t\t首次投入技能点时，每点意志提供的灵能值增加 0.5，每点体质提供的生命值减少 0.25。\n\t\t学习此技能也会增加你 10 %%唯我临界点（当前 %d%%）。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "a1c565abdcea14fa662beebdf5b77cf16f7e6b9a9b136841cd1b451f0d57978e",
      "notes": "User-authorized removal of unadopted mechanism expansions / concise wording.",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/psionic/solipsism.lua",
      "source": "Each time you take damage, you roll %d%% of your mental save against it.  A successful saving throw can crit and will reduce the damage by at least 50%%.\n\t\tThe first talent point invested will also increase the amount of Psi you gain from Willpower by 0.5, but reduce the amount of life you gain from Constitution by 0.25.\n\t\tThe first talent point also increases your solipsism threshold by 10%% (currently %d%%).",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "每当你受到伤害时，你会用精神豁免的 %d%% 与本次伤害数值进行一次检定。检定成功时可触发精神暴击，并会使伤害至少降低 50%%。\n\t\t首次投入技能点时，每点意志提供的灵能值增加 0.5，每点体质提供的生命值减少 0.25。\n\t\t学习此技能也会使你的唯我临界点提高 10%%（当前 %d%%）。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "392b9093d1b10e23b7b53a8af71823fb77bc6163bd918ff882743773d1be8bdc",
      "notes": "User-authorized removal of unadopted mechanism expansions / concise wording.",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/psionic/discharge.lua",
      "source": "Activate to invert your Feedback decay for %d turns.  This effect can be a critical hit, increasing the duration even further.\n\t\tYou must have some Feedback in order to start the loop.\n\t\tThe maximum Feedback gain will scale with your Mindpower.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "激活以逆转你的反馈值衰减，持续 %d 回合。此技能激活时可产生暴击效果，效果为增加技能持续时间。\n\t\t使用此技能时，你必须拥有一定的反馈值。\n\t\t受精神强度影响，反馈值的最大增加值按比例加成。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "451671dd70cadcb8eee1b1ed8ec95bab76fd1edfd6dfe6e599c9e3d64a7903d9",
      "notes": "User-authorized removal of unadopted mechanism expansions / concise wording.",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/psionic/mentalism.lua",
      "source": "Activate to project your mind from your body for %d turns.  In this state you're invisible (+%d power), can see invisible and stealthed creatures (+%d detection power), can move through walls, and do not need air to survive.\n\t\tAll damage you suffer is shared with your physical body, and while in this form you may only deal damage to 'ghosts' or through an active mind link (mind damage only in the second case.)\n\t\tTo return to your body, simply release control of the projection.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "激活此技能可以使你的灵魂出窍，持续 %d 回合。在此形态下，你处于隐形状态 （+%d 强度）。\n\t\t你可以看见隐形和潜行的生物 （+%d 侦查强度），穿过墙壁，且无需呼吸。\n\t\t你受到的所有伤害都会与肉身共享；你只能伤害“鬼魂”，或通过已激活的精神链接造成精神伤害。\n\t\t要回到你的身体里，只需放弃对灵魂投影的控制。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "1765eb9300ace89df5005567c50ff9a8a9d9423c91299f9007856a7016188712",
      "notes": "User-authorized removal of unadopted mechanism expansions / concise wording.",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/techniques/weaponshield.lua",
      "source": "Hit your target with your shield 3 times for %d%% damage then quickly return to a blocking position.  The bonus block will not check or trigger Block cooldown.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "用盾牌拍击目标 3 次，造成 %d%% 盾牌伤害，然后迅速进入格挡状态。\n\t\t这次额外格挡既不检查也不触发格挡技能的冷却。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "54d6805fe8266331c2ba6d2ed0f041bab733424cab6d057649190fdddd12eda9",
      "notes": "User-authorized removal of unadopted mechanism expansions / concise wording.",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/timed_effects/other.lua",
      "source": "Horrible visions fill your mind.\n#CRIMSON#Penalty : #WHITE#Plagued by Visions: Your mental save has a 20%% chance to be reduced by %d%% when tested.\n#CRIMSON#Power 1+: %sRemoved from Reality: %+d Physical Resistance, %+d Maximum Physical Resistance\n#CRIMSON#Power 2+: %s%+d Luck, %+d Willpower\n#CRIMSON#Power 3+: %sHarrow: When a foe attempts to inflict a detrimental effect upon you, your harrowing aura retaliates against a random foe in range 10, dealing %d mind and %d darkness damage.\n#CRIMSON#Power 4+: %sNightmare: Each time you are damaged by a foe there is a chance (currently %d%%) of triggering a radius %d nightmare (summon Terrors and chances to slow, deal %d Mind damage, and deal %d Darkness damage) for 8 turns. The chance grows each time you are struck but fades over time.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你的脑海中充斥恐怖景象。\n#CRIMSON# 惩罚：#WHITE# 幻象缠身：受检定时，你的精神豁免有 20%%概率减少 %d%%\n#CRIMSON# 强度 1+：%s 从现实消失：%+d 物理抗性，%+d 物理抗性上限\n#CRIMSON# 强度 2+：%s%+d 幸运，%+d 意志\n#CRIMSON# 强度 3+：%s 折磨：当敌人试图对你施加负面效果时，你的折磨光环会反击半径 10 内的一个随机敌人，造成 %d 精神和 %d 暗影伤害。\n#CRIMSON# 强度 4+：%s 噩梦：每次被敌人所伤有概率 (当前 %d%%) 触发一个范围为 %d 码的噩梦（召唤恐魔，并有几率减速、造成%d精神伤害和%d暗影伤害）持续 8 回合。触发几率在每次你受到打击时提高，同时随时间下降。"
    }
  ],
  "ok": true,

      "notes": "User-authorized removal of unadopted mechanism expansions / concise wording.",
      "section": "tome-ashes-urhrok/data/talents/corruptions/spellblaze.lua",
      "source": "Bringing about the darkest days of the Spellblaze you hasten the death of your foes.\n\t\tWhen you deal damage to a creature in radius %d or less around you and it dips below 33%% life you automatically unleash the fury of the Spellblaze.\n\t\tAffected foes will start taking %0.2f darkness damage each turn until it dies as long as it remains in radius %d of you.\n\t\tThe damage increases with spellpower.",

      "target": "重现魔法大爆炸最黑暗的时刻，加速敌人的死亡。\n\t\t当你对周围半径 %d 内的生物造成伤害，使其生命值降至 33%% 以下时，会自动向其释放魔法大爆炸之怒。\n\t\t受影响的敌人每回合受到 %0.2f 点暗影伤害；只要它仍在你周围半径 %d 内，伤害就会持续至其死亡。\n\t\t伤害受法术强度加成。"

      "notes": "User-authorized removal of unadopted mechanism expansions / concise wording.",
      "section": "tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua",
      "source": "The target is doomed to treason. Each turn they have a %d%% chance to attack an adjacent creature.  If no creatures are adjacent they will attack themself.",

    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "cults",
      "entry_id": "77e79762dde49e5f31c1ad1071373dbb9d5f7ccc415c82b857298fe544eb747c",
      "notes": "User-authorized removal of unadopted mechanism expansions / concise wording.",
      "section": "tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua",
      "source": "The target has %d increased saves and defense, and %d%% increased critical chance.",
      "source_tag": "_t",

    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "cults",
      "entry_id": "aa891c845a3423ded7c5adddd0b500132d0a214a32b2aa861fdd906530b07d43",
      "notes": "User-authorized removal of unadopted mechanism expansions / concise wording.",
      "section": "tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua",
      "source": "The target is engulfed in entropy, reducing the duration of new beneficial effects and increasing the duration of new negative effects by %d%%.\nThis effect will fade in 2 turns if the source is not in line of sight.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "目标被熵笼罩，新施加的有益效果持续时间缩短，负面效果持续时间延长，幅度均为 %d%%。\n若效果来源不在视野内，则该效果会在 2 回合后消失。"

      "entry_id": "f54c3f84c98a1114396e889da4cb83611e832aced18bc986cff0e6dcb388a005",

      "section": "tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua",
      "source": "True power is revealed!\n\nAll debuffs removed and all talent cooldowns reset on application.\n\nEach turn a radius 2 explosion will occur in a random space dealing %0.2f darkness and temporal damage and destroying any diggable walls.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",

      "target": "真正的力量正被揭示！\n\n施加该效果时，移除所有负面效果并重置所有技能冷却时间。\n\n每回合，一个半径 2 码的爆炸会在一个随机空间爆发，造成 %0.2f 暗影和时空伤害，并摧毁所有可挖掘的墙。"
    },

      "section": "tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua",
